_description: Structured log of pipeline outcomes. Written by gas-code-review-agent (reviews), deployment-agent (deploys), and other agents. Read by ALL agents during exploration phase and by /learnings command for trends.

p0.description: CLEARABLE_FIELDS used different key names than FIELD_CONFIG (cashDiscount vs cdDiscount, vips vs guestsOfNote) — silent mismatch meant some fields were not cleared

outcomes.rule_added: waratah-gas-agent P0: use getClearableFieldKeys_(), never maintain a parallel clearable list
learnings: CLEARABLE_FIELDS keys must match FIELD_CONFIG keys exactly — any parallel list will drift

outcomes.task: Formula cell B34 cleared during rollover

p0.description: CLEARABLE_FIELDS included netRevenue (formula cell) — rollover destroyed the formula

outcomes.rule_added: waratah-gas-agent + gas-code-review-agent: formula cells flagged isFormula:true in FIELD_CONFIG must never appear in clearable lists
learnings: Formula cells must have isFormula:true in FIELD_CONFIG and be excluded from all clearing operations

p0.description: TASK_CONFIG was extended with slack:{} keys — caused Cannot read properties of undefined (reading dmWebhooks)

outcomes.rule_added: task-management-agent P0: TASK_CONFIG must NOT contain Slack/email config
learnings: TASK_CONFIG is for task workflow only — Slack/email config lives in Script Properties, read at runtime

p0.description: Called clearContent() on a Sheet object — Sheet has clearContents() (plural), not clearContent()

outcomes.rule_added: Both venue agents + review agent: clearContent() only on Range; clearContents() only on Sheet
learnings: Range.clearContent() is singular; Sheet.clearContents() is plural; sheet.clearContent() does NOT exist
